title: Carol
description: Adds a super cute cat "Carol" from Maimai original song, "殿ッ！？ご乱心！？".
body:
![Carol Mod Thumbnail image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/65cb88018308e967a871d61d92e35713cb61ed8c_0.webp)

Adds a super cute cat "Carol" from Maimai original song, "殿ッ！？ご乱心！？".
You can spawn her with spawnegg.
Carol's behavior is almost same as minecraft cats.
This mod also comes with maimai tapnote item as throwables. It stucks on ground, and if you shoot it at Carol, she will reflect.
I will keep updating this mod to add more features.
